comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: Does anyone know if this aide skill still work against boss npc and big monster dudes at Labyrinth or Temple of Poseidon?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Not tested to the best of my knowledge but as items and trap techs work on the Temple of Poseidon bosses this ought to work on them as well (it's basically like the wine land battle item effect which also seals techs). Note that the Minotaur in the Labyrinth is apparently immune to all item/trap negative status ailments so I would imagine this won't work on him.
